observation: Front, top and iso inspected together as one contact sheet at 500 px a view. Square tile, top flush, with one smooth circular landing pad in the middle and a dense field of small pyramids filling the margin right out to all four edges. Front view shows the rubble standing proud of a plain slab and the pad sunk between it; top view shows the pad centred with no rubble inside it. Nothing floating, no pyramid detached from the floor, no part of the pad broken by rubble.
